units.zh: 列傳五十八
units.en: Biographies 58

units.zh: 徐乾學，字原一，江南崑山人。
units.en: Xu Qianxue, whose style was Yuanyi, came from Kunshan in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Xu Qianxue, style name Yuanyi, was a native of Kunshan in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 幼慧，八歳能文。
units.en: Precocious as a boy, he could already write essays at the age of eight.
units.literal: As a child he was clever; at eight sui he could compose essays.

units.zh: 康熙九年，一甲三名進士，授編修。
units.en: In Kangxi 9 he took third place in the top tier of the jinshi examination and was made a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi he placed third among the first rank of jinshi and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 十一年，副蔡啓僔主順天鄕試，拔韓菼於遺巻中，明年魁天下，文體一變。
units.en: In year 11 he served as associate examiner with Cai Qipu for the Shuntian provincial exam and picked Han Tan out of the discarded papers; Han took first place nationwide the following year, and examination prose was transformed overnight.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, as associate examiner with Cai Qipu for the Shuntian provincial examination, he selected Han Tan from among the rejected papers; the next year Han topped the empire and literary style changed at once.

units.zh: 坐副榜未取漢軍巻，與啓僔並鐫秩調用。
units.en: They were demoted and transferred for failing to admit any Han Army Banner papers on the supplementary list.
units.literal: Because the supplementary list had not taken Han Army papers, he and Qipu were both demoted in rank and reassigned.

units.zh: 尋復故官，遷左贊善，充日講起居注官。
units.en: He was soon reinstated, promoted to Left Assistant to the Heir Apparent, and made a Daily Lecturer and Recorder at court.
units.literal: Before long he was restored to his former post, promoted to Left Assistant to the Heir Apparent, and appointed Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.

units.zh: 丁母憂歸，乾學父先卒，哀毀三年，喪葬一以禮；
units.en: When his mother died he went home to mourn; his father had already passed away, and for three years he wore himself out in grief, observing every funeral rite to the letter;
units.literal: On entering mourning for his mother he returned home; Qianxue's father had died earlier, and for three years he grieved in devastation, conducting the funeral entirely according to ritual;

units.zh: 及母卒，如之。
units.en: when his mother died he did the same.
units.literal: when his mother died he did the same.

units.zh: 爲讀禮通考百二十巻，博採衆説，剖析其義。
units.en: He produced the Comprehensive Study of Ritual Reading in 120 juan, drawing widely on scholarly opinion and dissecting each point with care.
units.literal: He wrote the Comprehensive Study of Ritual Reading in 120 juan, broadly gathering many schools' views and analyzing their meaning.

units.zh: 服闋，起故官。
units.en: When his mourning period ended he returned to his former post.
units.literal: When mourning ended he resumed his former office.

units.zh: 充明史總裁官，累遷侍講學士。
units.en: He was appointed chief compiler of the History of Ming and rose step by step to Reader-in-Waiting.
units.literal: He served as chief compiler of the History of Ming and was promoted in succession to Reader-in-Waiting.

units.zh: 二十三年，乾學弟元文以左都御史降調，其子樹聲與乾學子樹屛並舉順天鄕試。
units.en: In year 23 Qianxue's brother Yuanwen was demoted from Left Censor-in-Chief; Yuanwen's son Shusheng and Qianxue's son Shuping both passed the Shuntian provincial exam.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, Qianxue's younger brother Yuanwen was demoted from Left Censor-in-Chief; Yuanwen's son Shusheng and Qianxue's son Shuping both passed the Shuntian provincial examination.

units.zh: 上以是科取中南皿巻皆江、浙人，而湖廣、江西、福建無一與者，下九卿科道磨勘。
units.en: The emperor saw that every successful candidate from the southern examination papers in this session came from Jiangsu or Zhejiang, while Huguang, Jiangxi, and Fujian had none at all, and ordered the Nine Ministers and censorate to scrutinize the papers again.
units.literal: The emperor, because in this session all who passed from the southern examination papers were men of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, while Huguang, Jiangxi, and Fujian had not a single one among them, ordered the Nine Ministers and the censorial and surveillance officials to re-examine the papers.

units.zh: 樹屛等坐斥舉人。
units.en: Shuping and the others were stripped of their juren degrees.
units.literal: Shuping and the others were punished by dismissal from juren status.

units.zh: 是年冬，乾學進詹事。
units.en: That winter Qianxue was promoted to Junior Mentor in the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: That winter Qianxue was promoted to Junior Mentor.

units.zh: 二十四年，召試翰詹諸臣，擢乾學第一，與侍讀韓菼、編修孫岳頒、侍講歸允肅、編修喬萊等四人並降敕褒獎賞賚。
units.en: In year 24 the Hanlin and Household corps were tested at court; Qianxue placed first, and he, Reader Han Tan, Compiler Sun Yuebin, Lecturer Gui Yunshu, and Compiler Qiao Lai all received imperial commendation and gifts.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Hanlin and Household officials were summoned for examination; Qianxue was ranked first, and together with Reader Han Tan, Compiler Sun Yuebin, Lecturer Gui Yunshu, and Compiler Qiao Lai—the four of them—received imperial edicts of praise and rewards.

units.zh: 尋直南書房，擢内閣學士，充大淸會典、一統志副總裁，教習庶吉士。
units.en: He was soon posted to the Southern Study, raised to Grand Secretariat academician, made associate chief compiler of the Qing Institutions and the Comprehensive Gazetteer, and put in charge of instructing Hanlin probationers.
units.literal: Soon he was assigned to the Southern Study, promoted to Grand Secretariat academician, appointed associate chief compiler of the Qing Institutions and the Comprehensive Gazetteer, and made instructor of Hanlin probationers.

units.zh: 時戸部郎中色楞額往福建稽察鼓鑄，請禁用明代舊錢，尚書科爾坤、餘國柱等議如所請。
units.en: Selenge, a director in the Ministry of Revenue, was then inspecting minting in Fujian and asked to outlaw Ming-era coin; Ministers Kelun, Yu Guozhu, and others agreed with his proposal.
units.literal: At the time Selenge, a director in the Ministry of Revenue, went to Fujian to inspect coin casting and requested a ban on Ming-era old cash; Ministers Kelun, Yu Guozhu, and others deliberated in favor of the request.

units.zh: 乾學言：「自古皆新舊兼行，以從民便。
units.en: Qianxue argued: "Throughout history old and new coin have circulated side by side for the people's convenience.
units.literal: Qianxue said: "From antiquity old and new coin have always circulated together for the people's convenience.

units.zh: 若設厲禁，恐滋紛擾。」
units.en: A harsh ban would only stir up trouble."
units.literal: If a harsh prohibition is imposed, I fear it will breed disorder."

units.zh: 因考自漢至明故事，爲議以獻。
units.en: He researched precedents from Han through Ming and submitted a memorial setting out his case.
units.literal: He therefore researched precedents from Han through Ming and submitted a memorial with his views.

units.zh: 上然之，事遂寢。
units.en: The emperor agreed, and the proposal was shelved.
units.literal: The emperor approved; the matter was then dropped.

units.zh: 詔採購遺書，乾學以宋、元經解、李燾續通鑑長編及唐開元禮，或繕寫，或仍古本，綜其體要，條列奏進，上稱善。
units.en: When the court ordered the acquisition of rare books, Qianxue submitted Song and Yuan classical commentaries, Li Tao's Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror, and the Tang Kaiyuan Rites—some freshly copied, some in antique editions—with a synopsis of each; the emperor commended his work.
units.literal: An edict ordered the purchase of surviving books; Qianxue presented Song and Yuan commentaries on the classics, Li Tao's Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror in Long Form, and the Tang Kaiyuan Rites—some copied out, some in original editions—summarized their essentials in listed form and memorialized them; the emperor praised the work.

units.zh: 時乾學與學士張英日侍左右，凡著作之任，皆以屬之。
units.en: Qianxue and Academician Zhang Ying were then in daily attendance on the emperor, and every literary commission was given to them.
units.literal: At the time Qianxue and Academician Zhang Ying attended daily at the emperor's side; every task of composition was entrusted to them.

units.zh: 學士例推巡撫，​​上以二人學問淹通，宜侍從，特諭吏部，遇巡撫缺勿預推。
units.en: Academicians were usually put forward for provincial governorships, but the emperor ruled that these two scholars were too valuable at court and expressly told the Board of Personnel not to nominate them for such posts.
units.literal: Academicians were routinely nominated for provincial governorships, but the emperor, because the two men's learning was broad and thorough and they were fit for attendance, specially instructed the Board of Personnel not to include them when a governorship fell vacant.

units.zh: 未幾，遷禮部侍郎，直講經筵。
units.en: Soon he was made Vice Minister of Rites and took a regular place lecturing at the Classics Colloquium.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites and lectured at the Classics Colloquium.

units.zh: 朝鮮使臣鄭載嵩訴其國王受枉，語悖妄。
units.en: The Korean envoy Zheng Zaisong petitioned that his king had been treated unjustly, speaking in terms that were insolent and absurd.
units.literal: The Korean envoy Zheng Zaisong complained that his king had been wronged, his words presumptuous and reckless.

units.zh: 乾學謂恐長外籓跋扈，劾其使臣失辭不敬，宜責以大義。
units.en: Qianxue warned that such talk would embolden tributary states; he impeached the envoy for disrespectful language and urged that he be sternly lectured on proper subordination.
units.literal: Qianxue said he feared this would encourage outer feudatories to grow overbearing; he impeached the envoy for improper, disrespectful speech and urged that he be rebuked in the name of the larger moral order.

units.zh: 上見疎，獎，謂有關國體。
units.en: The emperor read the memorial, praised it, and said it touched the honor of the realm.
units.literal: When the emperor saw the memorial he commended it, saying it concerned the dignity of the state.

units.zh: 已而王上疎謝罪。
units.en: The Korean king soon sent a memorial of apology.
units.literal: Before long the king submitted a memorial of apology.

units.zh: 二十六年，遷左都御史，擢刑部尚書。
units.en: In year 26 he became Left Censor-in-Chief and was promoted to Minister of Justice.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 二十七年，典會試。
units.en: In year 27 he served as chief examiner for the metropolitan civil service examination.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 初，明珠當國，勢張甚，其黨布中外，乾學不能立異同。
units.en: Earlier, when Mingzhu dominated the government, his faction was everywhere and Qianxue had not dared to oppose him openly.
units.literal: At first, when Mingzhu held power, his influence was greatly inflated and his faction spread inside and outside the court; Qianxue could not take a stand of difference or agreement.

units.zh: 至是，明珠漸失帝眷，而乾學驟拜左都御史，即劾罷江西巡撫安世鼎，諷諸御史風聞言事，臺諫多所彈劾，不避權貴。
units.en: By then Mingzhu was falling from favor, and Qianxue, suddenly made Left Censor-in-Chief, immediately brought down the Jiangxi governor An Shiding, encouraged censors to speak on rumor, and the remonstrance offices attacked many powerful men without flinching.
units.literal: By this time Mingzhu was gradually losing the emperor's favor, while Qianxue was suddenly appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; he at once impeached and removed Jiangxi Governor An Shiding, hinted to the censors that they should report on hearsay, and the remonstrance offices impeached many without shunning the powerful.

units.zh: 明珠竟罷相，衆皆謂乾學主之。
units.en: Mingzhu was finally driven from office, and most people credited Qianxue with orchestrating his fall.
units.literal: Mingzhu was finally dismissed from the premiership, and the multitude all said Qianxue had masterminded it.

units.zh: 時有南、北黨之目，互相抨撃。
units.en: Court factions were then labeled Southern and Northern, and they assailed one another relentlessly.
units.literal: At the time there were labels of Southern and Northern factions, attacking one another.

units.zh: 尚書科爾坤、佛倫，明珠黨也，乾學遇會議會推，輒與齟。
units.en: Ministers Kelun and Folun belonged to Mingzhu's faction; whenever Qianxue sat with them in council or nomination meetings, they were at odds.
units.literal: Ministers Kelun and Folun were of Mingzhu's party; whenever Qianxue met them in joint deliberation or nomination conferences, they clashed.

units.zh: 總河靳輔奏下河屯田，下九卿會議，乾學偕尚書張玉書言屯田所佔民地應歸舊業，科爾坤、佛倫勿從。
units.en: Jin Fu, director-general of the Yellow River, proposed garrison farming in the lower reaches; the Nine Ministers were convened, and Qianxue with Minister Zhang Yushu argued that seized farmland should be returned to its owners; Kelun and Folun dissented.
units.literal: Director-General of the Yellow River Jin Fu memorialized on opening garrison farms in the lower reaches; the matter was sent to the Nine Ministers for joint discussion; Qianxue together with Minister Zhang Yushu said the civilian land taken for garrison farms should revert to its original holders; Kelun and Folun would not agree.

units.zh: 御史陸祖修因劾科爾坤等偏袒河臣，不顧公議，御史郭琇亦劾輔興屯累民，詔罷輔任。
units.en: Censor Lu Zuxiu impeached Kelun and his allies for favoring the river official over public opinion; Censor Guo Xiu attacked Fu for garrison farming that oppressed the people; the emperor dismissed Fu from his post.
units.literal: Censor Lu Zuxiu thereupon impeached Kelun and others for partiality toward the river official and disregard of public opinion; Censor Guo Xiu also impeached Fu for garrison farming that burdened the people; an edict removed Fu from office.

units.zh: 湖廣巡撫張汧亦明珠私人，先是命色楞額往讞上荊南道祖澤深婪贓各款，並察汧有無穢跡，色楞額悉爲庇隱。
units.en: Huguang Governor Zhang Gan was another of Mingzhu's clients; Selenge had earlier been sent to try Zu Zeshen, intendant of Jingnan Circuit, on charges of corruption and to look into Zhang Gan as well, but Selenge covered up everything.
units.literal: Huguang Governor Zhang Gan was also Mingzhu's private man; earlier Selenge had been ordered to try and report the various counts of greedy corruption against Jingnan Circuit intendant Zu Zeshen, and also to investigate whether Gan had any taint; Selenge concealed everything.

units.zh: 御史陳紫芝劾汧貪黷，命副都御史開音布會巡撫於成龍、馬齊覆訊，汧、澤深事倶實，復得澤深交結大學士餘國柱爲囑色楞額徇庇及汧遣人赴京行賄狀，下法司嚴議。
units.en: Censor Chen Zizhi impeached Zhang Gan for corruption; Vice Censor-in-Chief Kaiyinbu was sent with Governors Yu Chenglong and Ma Qi to reinvestigate; both men's guilt was confirmed, and investigators also uncovered Zeshen's dealings with Grand Secretary Yu Guozhu to secure Selenge's protection and Zhang Gan's bribery agents in the capital; the judiciary was ordered to rule severely.
units.literal: Censor Chen Zizhi impeached Gan for greed and malfeasance; Vice Censor-in-Chief Kaiyinbu was ordered to join Governors Yu Chenglong and Ma Qi in re-examination; the cases against Gan and Zeshen were both substantiated, and it was further found that Zeshen had associated with Grand Secretary Yu Guozhu to ask Selenge to show favor, and that Gan had sent men to the capital to offer bribes; the matter was sent to the judiciary for strict deliberation.

units.zh: 時國柱已爲琇劾罷，法司請檄追質訊，並詰汧行賄何人，汧指乾學。
units.en: Yu Guozhu had already been impeached out of office by Guo Xiu; the judiciary asked to summon him for questioning and pressed Zhang Gan on who had received his bribes; Gan named Qianxue.
units.literal: By then Guozhu had already been impeached and removed by Guo Xiu; the judiciary requested a summons for cross-examination and also pressed Gan on whom he had bribed; Gan pointed at Qianxue.

units.zh: 上聞，命免國柱質訊，戒勿株連。
units.en: The emperor heard of it, exempted Guozhu from being summoned, and warned against widening the net.
units.literal: When the emperor heard this he ordered that Guozhu be exempted from cross-examination and warned against implicating others by association.

units.zh: 於是但論汧、澤深、色楞額如律，事遂寢。
units.en: Only Zhang Gan, Zu Zeshen, and Selenge were punished according to law, and the affair was closed.
units.literal: Thereupon only Gan, Zeshen, and Selenge were judged according to law, and the matter was dropped.

units.zh: 乾學尋乞罷，疎言：「臣蒙特達之知，感激矢報，苞苴餽遺，一切禁絶。
units.en: Qianxue soon asked to resign, writing: "I owe Your Majesty exceptional favor and would repay it with my life; I have refused every gift and bribe offered to me.
units.literal: Qianxue soon requested dismissal, memorializing: "Your servant has received the emperor's extraordinary favor and is moved to repay it with my life; gifts and presents I have forbidden entirely.

units.zh: 前任湖北巡撫張汧橫肆汙衊，縁臣爲憲長，拒其幣問，是以銜憾誣攀。
units.en: Former Huguang Governor Zhang Gan has slandered me wantonly; as his superior in the censorate I refused his gifts, and he bears a grudge and has falsely dragged me in.
units.literal: The former Huguang Governor Zhang Gan wantonly slandered me; because I was his superior in the censorate and refused his gifts and inquiries, he bore a grudge and falsely implicated me.

units.zh: 非聖明在上，是非幾至混淆。
units.en: Had Your Majesty not been on the throne, truth and falsehood might have been utterly confused.
units.literal: Had not the sage ruler been above, right and wrong would almost have been confused.

units.zh: 臣備位卿僚，乃爲貪吏誣構，皇上覆載之仁，不加譴責，臣復何顏出入禁廷，有玷淸班？
units.en: I hold ministerial rank yet have been framed by a corrupt official; Your Majesty's mercy has spared me punishment—how can I still walk the inner court and disgrace the pure service?
units.literal: Your servant holds a place among the ministers, yet a corrupt official has framed me; the emperor's all-enfolding kindness has not imposed censure—how can I again show my face entering the forbidden court and stain the pure ranks?

units.zh: 伏冀聖慈放歸田裡。」
units.en: I beg Your Majesty's compassion to let me return home."
units.literal: I humbly hope for sage compassion to release me to my fields and village."

units.zh: 詔許以原官解任，仍領修書總裁事。
units.en: The emperor allowed him to step down from active duty while keeping his rank and continuing as chief compiler of the official histories.
units.literal: An edict permitted him to resign his substantive post while retaining his former rank, and he continued to head the book-compilation directorship.

units.zh: 二十八年，元文拜大學士，乾學子樹穀考選御史。
units.en: In year 28 Yuanwen became Grand Secretary, and Qianxue's son Shugu passed the selection examination for the censorate.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Yuanwen was appointed Grand Secretary, and Qianxue's son Shugu was selected by examination for censor.

units.zh: 副都御史許三禮劾乾學：「律身不嚴，爲張汧所引。
units.en: Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Sanli impeached Qianxue: "He has not kept his conduct strict and was named by Zhang Gan.
units.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Sanli impeached Qianxue: "He does not discipline himself strictly and was implicated by Zhang Gan.

units.zh: 皇上寬仁，不加譴責，即宜引咎自退，乞命歸里。
units.en: The emperor has been merciful and has not punished him; he should accept blame and withdraw, begging leave to go home.
units.literal: The emperor has been lenient and has not censured him; he ought at once to take blame upon himself and withdraw, begging permission to return to his village.

units.zh: 又復優柔系戀，潛住長安。
units.en: Instead he wavers and clings to power, secretly remaining in the capital.
units.literal: Yet again he is irresolute and clings to office, secretly staying in Chang'an.

units.zh: 乘修史爲名，出入禁廷，與髙士奇相爲表裡。
units.en: Under cover of editing the histories he comes and goes within the palace, working hand in glove with Gao Shiqi.
units.literal: Under the pretext of compiling history he enters and leaves the forbidden court, acting in concert with Gao Shiqi inside and out.

units.zh: 物議沸騰，招搖納賄。
units.en: Public outrage is widespread; he trades on influence and takes bribes.
units.literal: Public talk boils over; he solicits and accepts bribes.

units.zh: 其子樹穀不遵成例，朦朧考選御史，明有所恃。
units.en: His son Shugu was irregularly passed in the censor selection, plainly counting on powerful protection.
units.literal: His son Shugu did not follow established precedent but was obscurely passed in the censor selection examination, clearly relying on backing.

units.zh: 獨其弟秉義文行兼優，原任禮部尚書熊賜履理學醇儒，乞立即召用，以佐盛治。
units.en: Only his younger brother Bingyi is outstanding in learning and conduct; former Minister of Rites Xiong Cilu is a true Neo-Confucian master—I urge that he be recalled immediately to help perfect the reign.
units.literal: Only his younger brother Bingyi excels in both literary and moral conduct; the former Minister of Rites Xiong Cilu is a pure scholar of Neo-Confucian learning—I beg that he be summoned at once to assist the flourishing rule.

units.zh: 乾學當逐出史館，樹穀應調部屬，以遵成例。」
units.en: Qianxue should be driven from the History Bureau and Shugu reassigned to a ministry post, as precedent requires."
units.literal: Qianxue should be expelled from the History Bureau; Shugu should be transferred to a ministry post to conform with precedent."

units.zh: 詔乾學復奏，乾學疎辨，乞罷斥歸田，並免樹穀職。
units.en: The emperor ordered Qianxue to respond; he memorialized in his own defense, asked to be dismissed and sent home, and requested that Shugu be stripped of his post.
units.literal: An edict ordered Qianxue to reply; Qianxue memorialized in defense, begging to be dismissed and sent home, and also to have Shugu removed from office.

units.zh: 疎皆下部議，坐三禮所劾無實，應鐫秩調用。
units.en: Both memorials went to the ministries for review; Sanli's charges were found baseless and he was to be demoted and transferred.
units.literal: The memorials were all sent to the ministries for deliberation; on the ground that Sanli's charges were unsubstantiated, he should be demoted in rank and reassigned.

units.zh: 三禮益恚，复列款訐乾學贓罪，帝嚴斥之，免降調，仍留任。
units.en: Sanli, furious, drew up a new list of corruption charges against Qianxue; the emperor rebuked him sharply, spared him demotion, and let him keep his post.
units.literal: Sanli grew still more enraged and again listed items accusing Qianxue of corruption; the emperor sternly rebuked him, exempted him from demotion and transfer, and allowed him to remain in office.

units.zh: 是年冬，乾學复上疎言：「臣年六十，精神衰耗，祗以受恩深重，依戀徘徊。
units.en: That winter Qianxue memorialized again: "I am sixty years old and my strength is failing; only the depth of Your Majesty's favor has kept me lingering on.
units.literal: That winter Qianxue again memorialized: "Your servant is sixty years old; my spirit is worn and depleted; only because the favor received is so deep have I lingered in attachment.

units.zh: 三禮私怨逞忿，幸聖主洞燭幽隱。
units.en: Sanli pursued a private vendetta; fortunately Your Majesty saw through his malice.
units.literal: Sanli vented private resentment; fortunately the sage ruler penetrated what was hidden.

units.zh: 臣方寸靡寧，不能复事鉛槧。
units.en: My mind is no longer at peace and I cannot again devote myself to scholarship.
units.literal: Your servant's heart is without peace and cannot again attend to brush and ink.

units.zh: 且恐因循居此，更有無端彈射。
units.en: I fear that if I stay on, more baseless attacks will follow.
units.literal: Moreover I fear that by lingering here there will be further groundless impeachments.

units.zh: 乞恩終始矜全，俾得保其衰病之身，歸省先臣丘隴，庶身心閒暇。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty's mercy from first to last, that I may preserve my failing health, return to tend my parents' graves, and find some peace.
units.literal: I beg grace from beginning to end in sparing completeness, that I may preserve this declining, ailing body, return to visit my forebears' mounds, and perhaps find leisure for body and mind.

units.zh: 原比古人書局自隨之義，屛跡編摩，少報萬一。」
units.en: I would follow the ancient custom of taking the editorial office home, work on the histories in seclusion, and repay even a fraction of Your Majesty's kindness."
units.literal: I wish to follow the ancient meaning of carrying the book office with oneself, withdraw from sight to edit and polish, and repay one ten-thousandth of the debt."

units.zh: 乃許給假回籍，降旨褒嘉，命攜書籍即家編輯。
units.en: He was granted leave to return home; the emperor issued a commendatory edict and ordered him to take the books with him and continue editing there.
units.literal: He was then permitted leave to return to his native place; an edict of praise was issued, ordering him to take books and edit at home.

units.zh: 二十九年春，陛辭，賜御書「光焰萬丈」榜額。
units.en: In the spring of year 29, at his farewell audience, the emperor bestowed his own calligraphy, "Radiance Ten Thousand Zhang," as a plaque.
units.literal: In the spring of the twenty-ninth year, at his farewell audience, he was granted an imperial inscription reading "Radiance Ten Thousand Zhang" as a plaque.

units.zh: 未幾，兩江總督傅臘塔疎劾乾學囑託蘇州府貢監等請建生祠，复縱其子侄交結巡撫洪之傑，倚勢競利，請敕部嚴議。
units.en: Soon the Liangjiang governor-general Fulata impeached Qianxue for arranging tribute students in Suzhou to petition for a living shrine, and for letting his sons and nephews collude with Governor Hong Zhijie to trade on influence for profit; he asked the ministries to investigate severely.
units.literal: Before long the Liangjiang Governor-General Fulata memorialized impeaching Qianxue for instructing Suzhou prefectural tribute students and others to request a living shrine, and again for indulging his sons and nephews in associating with Governor Hong Zhijie, relying on power to compete for profit; he requested that the ministries be ordered to deliberate strictly.

units.zh: 語具元文傳。
units.en: The full account appears in Yuanwen's biography.
units.literal: The account is given in full in Yuanwen's biography.

units.zh: 上置弗問，而予元文休致。
units.en: The emperor ignored the charges against Qianxue but allowed Yuanwen to retire.
units.literal: The emperor set it aside without inquiry but granted Yuanwen retirement.

units.zh: 三十年，山東巡撫佛倫劾濰縣知縣硃敦厚加收火耗論死，並及乾學嘗致書前任巡撫錢鎯庇敦厚。
units.en: In year 30 Shandong Governor Folun charged Weixian magistrate Zhu Dunhou with illegal surcharges and sought his execution, also citing Qianxue's letter to former governor Qian Hao shielding Zhu.
units.literal: In the thirtieth year Shandong Governor Folun impeached Weixian magistrate Zhu Dunhou for imposing extra meltage fees and sought the death penalty, also implicating Qianxue for having once written to the former governor Qian Hao to shield Dunhou.

units.zh: 乾學與鎯倶坐是奪職。
units.en: Qianxue and Qian Hao were both stripped of their posts for this.
units.literal: Qianxue and Hao were both punished by dismissal from office on this account.

units.zh: 自是齮齕者不已。
units.en: From then on his enemies never let up.
units.literal: From this time those who gnawed at him did not cease.

units.zh: 嘉定知縣聞在上爲縣民訐告私派，逮獄，閲二年未定讞。
units.en: Jiading magistrate Wen Zaishang was denounced by local people for illegal levies, thrown into prison, and after two years still had no final verdict.
units.literal: Jiading magistrate Wen Zaishang was impeached by county people for unauthorized levies, arrested and imprisoned; after two years judgment was still unsettled.

units.zh: 按察使髙承爵窮詰，在上自承嘗餽乾學子樹敏金，至事發後追還，因坐樹敏罪論絞。
units.en: Surveillance Commissioner Gao Chengjue pressed the case hard; Zaishang admitted he had once given gold to Qianxue's son Shumin, though he tried to return it after the scandal broke; Shumin was convicted and sentenced to death by strangulation.
units.literal: Surveillance commissioner Gao Chengjue pressed the inquiry to the limit; Zaishang confessed that he had once presented gold to Qianxue's son Shumin, which after the affair broke was pursued and returned; on this account Shumin was convicted and sentenced to strangulation.

units.zh: 會詔戒内外各官私怨報復，樹敏得贖罪。
units.en: An edict then warned officials against pursuing private vendettas, and Shumin was permitted to commute his sentence.
units.literal: It happened that an edict warned all officials inside and outside against private revenge; Shumin was allowed to redeem his crime.

units.zh: 三十三年，諭大學士舉長於文章學問超卓者，王熙、張玉書等薦乾學與王鴻緒、髙士奇，命來京修書。
units.en: In year 33 the emperor told the Grand Secretaries to nominate men of exceptional literary and scholarly talent; Wang Xi, Zhang Yushu, and others recommended Qianxue along with Wang Hongxu and Gao Shiqi, and the court ordered them to Beijing to work on the histories.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year the emperor instructed the Grand Secretaries to recommend those outstanding in literary composition and learning; Wang Xi, Zhang Yushu, and others recommended Qianxue together with Wang Hongxu and Gao Shiqi, and they were ordered to come to the capital to compile books.

units.zh: 乾學已前卒，遺疎以所纂一統志進，詔下所司，復故官。
units.en: Qianxue had already died; his last memorial presented the Comprehensive Gazetteer he had compiled; the emperor ordered it forwarded to the proper offices and posthumously restored his former rank.
units.literal: Qianxue had already died earlier; his final memorial presented the Comprehensive Gazetteer he had compiled; an edict sent it to the relevant offices and restored his former rank.

units.zh: 翁叔元，字寶林，江南常熟人。
units.en: Weng Shuyuan, whose style was Baolin, came from Changshu in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Weng Shuyuan, style name Baolin, was a native of Changshu in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 康熙十五年，一甲三名進士，授編修，館試第一。
units.en: In Kangxi 15 he took third place in the top tier of the jinshi examination, became a Hanlin compiler, and placed first in the academy examination.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi he placed third among the first rank of jinshi, was appointed compiler, and ranked first in the Hanlin examination.

units.zh: 累遷國子監祭酒，洊擢吏部侍郎，遷工部尚書。
units.en: He rose through the ranks to Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, was soon made Vice Minister of Personnel, and then Minister of Works.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Chancellor of the Directorate of Education, then rapidly raised to Vice Minister of Personnel, and transferred to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 部例，毎有工作，先計其直上之，名曰「料估」。
units.en: Ministry rules required every project to have its costs estimated and reported upward first—this was called the "material estimate."
units.literal: According to ministry precedent, whenever there was a project the cost was first calculated and reported upward; this was called "material estimate."

units.zh: 工完多冒破，所司不敢以聞，有十年不銷算者，大工至四十三案。
units.en: When projects finished, officials often padded expenses, and the responsible clerks dared not report it; some accounts sat uncleared for ten years, and major works alone left forty-three open cases.
units.literal: When work was finished there was often fraudulent overspending; the responsible offices dared not report it; some accounts went ten years without clearance; major projects reached forty-three open cases.

units.zh: 叔元蒞部甫半載，積牘一淸。
units.en: Shuyuan had headed the ministry only six months when he cleared the entire backlog.
units.literal: Shuyuan had been at the ministry only half a year when the accumulated papers were entirely cleared.

units.zh: 調邢部，移疾歸，卒。
units.en: He was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, resigned on grounds of illness, and died at home.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, pleaded illness and returned home, and died.

units.zh: 叔元愛才而褊隘，何焯在門下，初甚賞之；
units.en: Shuyuan loved talent but was petty; He Chao studied under him and was highly regarded at first;
units.literal: Shuyuan loved talent but was narrow-minded; He Chao was among his disciples and at first was greatly favored;

units.zh: 叔元疎劾湯斌，焯請削門生籍，叔元擯之，竟不得成名。
units.en: when Shuyuan impeached Tang Bin, Chao asked to be struck from his register of disciples; Shuyuan cast him out, and he never won recognition.
units.literal: when Shuyuan memorialized impeaching Tang Bin, Chao asked to have his name struck from the register of disciples; Shuyuan ostracized him, and in the end he never achieved fame.

units.zh: 以是爲世所誚雲。
units.en: For this the world held him in contempt.
units.literal: For this he was mocked by the world.

units.zh: 王鴻緒，初名度心，字季友，江南婁縣人。
units.en: Wang Hongxu, originally named Duxin and styled Jiyou, came from Lou County in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Wang Hongxu, original name Duxin, style name Jiyou, was a native of Lou County in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 康熙十二年一甲二名進士，授編修。
units.en: In Kangxi 12 he took second place in the top tier of the jinshi examination and was made a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi he placed second among the first rank of jinshi and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 十四年，主順天鄕試。
units.en: In year 14 he served as chief examiner for the Shuntian provincial exam.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

units.zh: 充日講起居注官。
units.en: He was made a Daily Lecturer and Recorder at court.
units.literal: He was appointed Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.

units.zh: 累遷翰林院侍講。
units.en: He rose step by step to Lecturer in the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Lecturer in the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 十九年，聖祖諭獎講官勤勞，加鴻緒侍讀學士銜。
units.en: In year 19 the Kangxi Emperor commended the lecturers' diligence and granted Hongxu the titular rank of Reader-in-Waiting.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year the Sacred Ancestor praised the lecturers' diligence and added for Hongxu the titular rank of Reader-in-Waiting.

units.zh: 時湖廣有硃方旦者，自號二眉山人。
units.en: At that time a man named Zhu Fangdan in Huguang called himself the Hermit of the Two Eyebrows.
units.literal: At the time in Huguang there was Zhu Fangdan, who styled himself the Hermit of the Two Eyebrows.

units.zh: 造中説補，聚徒橫議，常至數千人。
units.en: He wrote a supplement to the Doctrine of the Mean, gathered disciples, and preached boldly to crowds that often numbered in the thousands.
units.literal: He composed a supplement to the Doctrine of the Mean, gathered disciples, and lectured recklessly, often reaching several thousand people.

units.zh: 自詡前知，與人決休咎。
units.en: He claimed to know the future and told people's fortunes.
units.literal: He boasted of foreknowledge and divined good and ill fortune for others.

units.zh: 巡撫董國興劾其左道惑衆，逮至京，得旨寬釋。
units.en: Governor Dong Guoxing charged him with heterodox doctrines that led the people astray; after he was brought to Beijing, the emperor ordered him released.
units.literal: Governor Dong Guoxing impeached him for heterodox ways that misled the masses; he was arrested and brought to the capital, and received an edict releasing him leniently.

units.zh: 及呉三桂反，順承郡王勒爾錦駐師荊州，方旦以佔驗出入軍營，巡撫張朝珍亦稱爲異人。
units.en: When Wu Sangui rose in rebellion, Prince Le'erjin of Shuncheng encamped at Jingzhou; Zhu Fangdan went in and out of the army camps practicing divination, and Governor Zhang Chaozhen also hailed him as a man of extraordinary powers.
units.literal: When Wu Sangui rebelled, the Prince of Shuncheng Le'erjin stationed his army at Jingzhou; Fangdan entered and left the military camps by means of divination, and Governor Zhang Chaozhen also called him a wonder-worker.

units.zh: 上密戒勒爾錦勿爲所惑。
units.en: The emperor secretly admonished Le'erjin not to let himself be deceived.
units.literal: The emperor secretly warned Le'erjin not to be misled by him.

units.zh: 方旦乃避走江、浙，會鴻緒得其所刊中質秘書，遂以奏進，列其誣罔君上、悖逆聖道、搖惑人心三大罪。
units.en: Fangdan fled to the Jiangsu and Zhejiang region; Wang Hongxu happened to obtain the esoteric work Zhongzhi Mishu that Fangdan had published, presented it to the throne, and charged him with three capital offenses—deceiving the emperor, violating the sage Way, and subverting popular sentiment.
units.literal: Fangdan then fled to Jiangsu and Zhejiang; it happened that Hongxu obtained the secret book Zhongzhi Mishu that he had printed, submitted it to the throne, and listed three great crimes: deceiving and misleading the sovereign, rebelling against the sacred Way, and shaking and deluding the hearts of the people.

units.zh: 方旦坐誅。
units.en: Zhu Fangdan was executed.
units.literal: Fangdan was punished with execution.

units.zh: 二十一年，轉侍讀，充明史總裁。
units.en: In year 21 he was made a Hanlin Reader and appointed chief compiler of the Ming history.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Reader, and appointed chief compiler of the History of Ming.

units.zh: 累擢内閣學士、戸部侍郎。
units.en: He rose step by step to Grand Secretariat academician and Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Secretariat academician and Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 二十四年，典會試。
units.en: In year 24 he served as chief examiner for the metropolitan civil service examination.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 二十五年，疎請回籍治本生母喪，遣官賜祭。
units.en: In year 25 he asked to return home to mourn his birth mother; the court sent officials with offerings for the funeral rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized requesting leave to return to his native place to observe mourning for his biological mother; officials were dispatched to grant sacrificial offerings.

units.zh: 二十六年，擢左都御史。
units.en: In year 26 he was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 疎劾廣東巡撫李士楨貪劣，潮州知府林杭學嘗從呉三桂反，乃舉其淸廉。
units.en: He impeached Guangdong Governor Li Shizhen for corruption, yet praised Chaozhou Prefect Lin Hangxue—who had once joined Wu Sangui's rebellion—as upright and honest.
units.literal: He memorialized impeaching Guangdong Governor Li Shizhen as greedy and base, while praising Chaozhou prefect Lin Hangxue, who had once followed Wu Sangui in rebellion, as pure and incorrupt.

units.zh: 士楨坐罷，杭學奪職。
units.en: Li Shizhen was removed from office and Lin Hangxue was dismissed.
units.literal: Shizhen was dismissed from office; Hangxue was stripped of his post.

units.zh: 會靈臺郎董漢臣疎陳時事，以諭教元良、愼簡宰執爲言。
units.en: Around this time Dong Hanchen, a director at the Astronomy Bureau, submitted a memorial on state affairs urging proper education for the crown prince and careful selection of chief ministers.
units.literal: It happened that Astronomy Bureau Director Dong Hanchen memorialized on current affairs, speaking of instructing the heir apparent and carefully selecting chief ministers.

units.zh: 御史陶式玉劾漢臣摭拾浮言，欺世盜名，請逮治。
units.en: Censor Tao Shiyu charged Dong Hanchen with peddling empty talk to win fame and asked that he be arrested.
units.literal: Censor Tao Shiyu impeached Hanchen for picking up floating words, deceiving the world and stealing reputation, and requested arrest and punishment.

units.zh: 鴻緒疎言：「欽天監靈臺郎、博士等官，不擇流品，星卜屠沽之徒，粗識數字，便得濫竽。
units.en: Wang Hongxu wrote: "At the Astronomy Bureau, directors and doctoral fellows are not chosen for merit; fortune-tellers, butchers, and hawkers who barely know their numbers still slip into office.
units.literal: Hongxu memorialized, saying: "Directors and doctors at the Directorate of Astronomy do not select for quality of character; star-diviners, butchers, and peddlers who barely know a few characters are allowed to fill posts improperly.

units.zh: 請敕下考試，分別去留。」
units.en: He asked the emperor to order examinations and weed out the unqualified."
units.literal: I request an imperial order for examination below, distinguishing whom to retain and dismiss."

units.zh: 下部議行。
units.en: The ministries deliberated and carried out the proposal.
units.literal: The memorial was sent to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 漢臣及博士賈文然等十五人並以詞理舛誤黜。
units.en: Dong Hanchen and fifteen others, including Doctor Jia Wenran, were all dismissed for defects in their written submissions.
units.literal: Hanchen and fifteen others including Doctor Jia Wenran were all dismissed for errors in wording and reasoning.

units.zh: 初，以式玉疎下九卿集議，尚書湯斌謂大臣不言，慚對漢臣。
units.en: When Tao Shiyu's memorial was first referred to the Nine Ministers, Minister Tang Bin declared that senior officials who held their tongues should be ashamed before Dong Hanchen.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shiyu's memorial was sent down for deliberation by the Nine Ministers, Minister Tang Bin said that if great ministers did not speak out, he was ashamed to face Hanchen.

units.zh: 漢臣既黜，鴻緒偕左都御史璙丹、副都御史徐元珙合疎劾斌務名鮮實，並追論江寧巡撫去任時，巧飾文告，以博虚譽。
units.en: After Dong Hanchen's dismissal, Wang Hongxu joined Left Censor-in-Chief Kuang Dan and Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Yuanqi in impeaching Tang Bin for cultivating a reputation without substance, and for having, as Jiangning governor on leaving office, dressed up his farewell proclamations to win hollow acclaim.
units.literal: After Hanchen was dismissed, Hongxu together with Left Censor-in-Chief Kuang Dan and Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Yuanqi jointly memorialized impeaching Bin for pursuing reputation without substance, and also pursued criticism of when he was governor of Jiangning and left office, cleverly embellishing proclamations to win empty praise.

units.zh: 上素重斌淸廉，置弗問。
units.en: The emperor had long esteemed Tang Bin's integrity and took no action.
units.literal: The emperor had long valued Bin's purity and integrity and set the matter aside without inquiry.

units.zh: 鴻緒論各省駐防官兵累民，略言：「駐防將領恃威放肆，或占奪民業，或重息放債，或強娶民婦。
units.en: Wang Hongxu memorialized on how provincial garrison troops oppressed the populace: "Garrison officers abuse their authority—seizing people's property, lending at crushing interest, or forcing commoners' wives into marriage.
units.literal: Hongxu discussed how garrison troops in the provinces burdened the people, stating in summary: "Garrison commanders rely on their power and act recklessly, or seize commoners' property, or lend money at usurious rates, or forcibly marry commoners' wives.

units.zh: 或謊詐逃人，株連良善；
units.en: They falsely accuse runaway bondsmen and entangle innocent families;
units.literal: Or they falsely accuse fugitives and implicate the innocent;

units.zh: 或收羅姦棍，巧生扎詐。
units.en: or they gather ruffians and contrive blackmail.
units.literal: or they recruit rogues and cunningly devise extortion.

units.zh: 種種爲害，所在時有。
units.en: Such abuses appeared everywhere.
units.literal: Harm of every kind occurs from time to time everywhere.

units.zh: 如西安、荊州駐防官兵紀律太寬，牧放馬匹，驅赴邨莊，累民芻秣；
units.en: At Xi'an and Jingzhou, for instance, garrison discipline was slack: troops pastured their horses in villages and forced locals to supply fodder;
units.literal: For example, garrison troops at Xi'an and Jingzhou were too lax in discipline; pasturing horses they drove them to village hamlets, burdening the people with fodder;

units.zh: 百十成群，踐食田禾，所至驛騷。
units.en: bands of a hundred or more trampled the crops and spread unrest wherever they marched.
units.literal: forming groups of a hundred or ten, they trampled and ate the standing grain, causing disturbance wherever they went.

units.zh: 其他苦累，又可類推。
units.en: Other burdens, he said, were much the same.
units.literal: Other hardships could be inferred by analogy.

units.zh: 請嚴飭將軍、副都統等力行約束。
units.en: He urged the generals and lieutenant-generals to enforce discipline strictly.
units.literal: I request stern orders to generals, vice commandants-in-chief, and others to enforce restraint.

units.zh: 緑旗提、鎭縱兵害民，以及虚冒兵糧者，不一而足，請飭督撫立行指參。」
units.en: Green Standard brigade and regimental commanders who let their men prey on civilians, and officers who padded the muster rolls, were legion; he asked governors and governor-generals to impeach them at once."
units.literal: Green Banner brigade and regiment commanders who indulged troops harming the people, and those who falsely claimed soldiers' rations, were more than could be listed; I request orders to governors and governors-general to impeach them promptly."

units.zh: 上命議行。
units.en: The emperor ordered the ministries to act on his recommendations.
units.literal: The emperor ordered deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 未幾，以父憂歸。
units.en: Soon afterward he went into mourning for his father and returned home.
units.literal: Before long he returned home on account of his father's mourning.

units.zh: 二十八年，服闋，將赴補。
units.en: In year 28, when his mourning period ended, he prepared to resume office.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, when mourning ended, he was about to return to his post.

units.zh: 左都御史郭琇劾鴻緒與髙士奇招權納賄，並及給事中何楷、編修陳元龍，皆予休致。
units.en: Left Censor-in-Chief Guo Xiu charged Wang Hongxu and Gao Shiqi with trading in influence and taking bribes, and also named Supervising Secretary He Kai and Compiler Chen Yuanlong; all were forced to retire.
units.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Guo Xiu impeached Hongxu and Gao Shiqi for manipulating power and taking bribes, also implicating Supervising Secretary He Kai and Compiler Chen Yuanlong; all were granted retirement.

units.zh: 語具士奇傳。
units.en: The full account appears in Gao Shiqi's biography.
units.literal: The account is given in full in Shiqi's biography.

units.zh: 嘉定知縣聞在上爲縣民訐告私派事，按察使髙承爵按治。
units.en: Jiading magistrate Wen Zaishang was denounced by local people for illegal levies; Surveillance Commissioner Gao Chengjue investigated.
units.literal: Jiading magistrate Wen Zaishang was impeached by county people for unauthorized levies; Surveillance Commissioner Gao Chengjue investigated.

units.zh: 在上言嘗以銀餽​​舉人徐樹敏，至事發退還，因坐樹敏罪。
units.en: Wen Zaishang admitted he had once given silver to the provincial graduate Xu Shumin; after the scandal surfaced he tried to return it, and Xu Shumin was convicted on that basis.
units.literal: Zaishang stated that he had once presented silver to provincial graduate Xu Shumin; when the affair broke out he returned it, and on this account Shumin was convicted.

units.zh: 巡撫鄭端覆訊，在上言嘗以銀五百餽鴻緒，亦事發退還。
units.en: Governor Zheng Duan reopened the inquiry; Wen Zaishang also admitted he had once given Wang Hongxu five hundred taels of silver, which he likewise returned when exposed.
units.literal: Governor Zheng Duan re-examined the case; Zaishang stated that he had once presented five hundred taels of silver to Hongxu, which was also returned when the affair broke out.

units.zh: 端乃劾乾學縱子行詐，鴻緒竟染贓銀，有玷大臣名節，乞敕部嚴議。
units.en: Zheng Duan then charged Xu Qianxue with letting his son practice fraud and Wang Hongxu with accepting tainted silver, arguing that both had disgraced the standing of senior ministers and asking the ministries for a severe ruling.
units.literal: Duan then impeached Qianxue for indulging his son in fraudulent conduct and Hongxu for having been stained by bribe silver, dishonoring the integrity expected of grand ministers, and begged that the ministries be ordered to deliberate strictly.

units.zh: 上特諭曰：「朕崇尚德教，蠲滌煩苛。
units.en: The emperor issued a special edict: "I value moral cultivation and seek to remove petty harassment from government.
units.literal: The emperor issued a special instruction, saying: "I esteem virtue and instruction and sweep away vexatious severity.

units.zh: 凡大小臣工，咸思恩禮下逮，曲全始終；
units.en: Every official, high or low, should remember that imperial grace extends downward and that the court wishes to see them through from start to finish;
units.literal: All ministers great and small should think how gracious favor reaches down and how to preserve them roundly from beginning to end;

units.zh: 即因事放歸，仍令各安田裡。
units.en: even those sent home on some charge are still expected to live quietly in their home districts.
units.literal: even when dismissed on account of some affair, they are still ordered each to settle peacefully in their native villages.

units.zh: 近見諸臣彼此傾軋，伐異黨同，私怨相尋，牽連報復；
units.en: Lately I have watched officials tear one another down, attack outsiders and reward their own factions, nurse private grievances, and pursue vendettas without end;
units.literal: Recently I have seen ministers overthrow one another, cut down the unlike and band with the like, pursue private resentments in succession, and drag one another into retaliation;

units.zh: 雖業已解職投閒，仍復吹求不已，株連逮於子弟，顛覆及於身家。
units.en: even after a man has resigned and withdrawn from office, his enemies still hunt for new charges, ruining his sons and bringing disaster on his entire household.
units.literal: although already dismissed and living in retirement, they still incessantly fish for offenses, implicating sons and younger brothers, overturning whole families.

units.zh: 朕總攬萬機，已三十年，此等情態，知之甚悉。
units.en: I have held the reins of government for thirty years and know these habits all too well.
units.literal: I have personally directed all affairs of state for thirty years and know these attitudes very thoroughly.

units.zh: 媢嫉傾軋之害，歴代皆有，而明季爲甚。
units.en: Factional jealousy has plagued every dynasty, but nowhere more ruinously than in the late Ming.
units.literal: The harm of jealous overthrow was found in every dynasty, but was especially severe in the late Ming.

units.zh: 公家之事，置若罔聞，而分樹黨援，飛誣排陷，迄無虚日。
units.en: They ignored the business of the state, built party networks, and filled the air with slander and intrigue without a day's respite.
units.literal: Matters of public business they treated as unheard; instead they set up factional support, sent flying accusations, and plotted exclusion, so that not a day passed without it.

units.zh: 朕於此等背公誤國之人，深切痛恨。
units.en: I despise men who betray the public interest and harm the realm.
units.literal: Toward such men who betray the public and harm the state I feel deep hatred.

units.zh: 自今以往，内外大小諸臣，宜各端心術，盡蠲私忿，共矢公忠。
units.en: From this day forward every official, within the capital or beyond, should purge private spite and devote himself to public duty.
units.literal: From now on, all ministers inside and outside, great and small, should each straighten their hearts and methods, utterly cast off private anger, and together pledge public loyalty.

units.zh: 儻仍執迷不悟，复踵前非，朕將窮極根株，悉坐以朋黨之罪。」
units.en: If they persist in these errors, I will trace every connection and punish the whole clique."
units.literal: If they still cling to error without awakening and again tread former wrongs, I shall trace the roots to the utmost and punish them all with the crime of faction."

units.zh: 時鴻緒方就質，詔至，得釋。
units.en: Wang Hongxu was under investigation when the edict arrived, and he was released.
units.literal: At the time Hongxu was being interrogated; when the edict arrived, he was released.

units.zh: 三十三年，以薦召來京修書。
units.en: In year 33 he was recalled to Beijing on recommendation to work on the histories.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year, on recommendation he was summoned to the capital to compile books.

units.zh: 尋授工部尚書，充經筵講官。
units.en: He was soon made Minister of Works and a lecturer at the imperial classics lectures.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Minister of Works and made lecturer at the classics lecture.

units.zh: 四十七年，調戸部。
units.en: In year 47 he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 其年冬，皇太子允礽既廢，詔大臣保奏儲貳，鴻緒與内大臣阿靈阿、侍郎揆敘等謀，舉皇子允禩，詔切責，以原品休致。
units.en: That winter, after Crown Prince Yinreng had been deposed, the emperor ordered senior ministers to nominate a successor; Wang Hongxu joined Inner Court minister Aring'a, Vice Minister Kui Xu, and others in backing Prince Yunsi; the emperor rebuked them sharply and sent them home at their former rank.
units.literal: That winter the crown prince Yinreng having already been deposed, an edict ordered grand ministers to recommend a successor to the heirship; Hongxu with Inner Court grand minister Aring'a, Vice Minister Kui Xu, and others plotted to recommend the prince Yunsi; the edict sternly rebuked them and they were granted retirement at their original rank.

units.zh: 五十三年，疎言：「臣舊居館職，奉命爲明史總裁官，與湯斌、徐乾學、葉方靄互相參訂，僅成數巻。
units.en: In year 53 he wrote: "I once served in the Hanlin Academy as chief compiler of the Ming history, working with Tang Bin, Xu Qianxue, and Ye Fang'ai; we completed only a few fascicles.
units.literal: In the fifty-third year he memorialized, saying: "Your servant formerly held a Hanlin post and was ordered to serve as chief compiler of the History of Ming; with Tang Bin, Xu Qianxue, and Ye Fang'ai he consulted and revised one another, completing only several fascicles.

units.zh: 及臣回籍多年，恩召重領史局，而前此纂輯諸臣，罕有存者。
units.en: After I returned home for many years the court graciously recalled me to head the history project, but most of my earlier colleagues were gone.
units.literal: When your servant returned to his native place for many years and was graciously summoned to head the historiographical bureau again, few of the former editors survived.

units.zh: 惟大學士張玉書爲監修，尚書陳廷敬爲總裁，各專一類：玉書任志，廷敬任本紀，臣任列傳。
units.en: Only Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu served as supervising compiler and Minister Chen Tingjing as chief compiler—Zhang handled the treatises, Chen the annals, and I the biographies.
units.literal: Only Grand Secretary Zhang Yushu served as supervising compiler and Minister Chen Tingjing as chief compiler, each specializing in one category: Yushu took the treatises, Tingjing the annals, and your servant the biographies.

units.zh: 因臣原銜食俸，比二臣得有馀暇，刪繁就簡，正謬訂譌。
units.en: Because I still drew my original salary, I had more time than the other two to prune redundant passages and correct errors.
units.literal: Because your servant held his original rank and salary, compared with the two ministers he had surplus leisure to cut the redundant and keep the essential, correct errors and fix mistakes.

units.zh: 如是數年，匯分成帙，而大學士熊賜履續奉監修之命，檄取傳稿以進，玉書、廷敬暨臣皆未參閲。
units.en: After several years the biographies were assembled, but Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü, who had succeeded to the supervising post, requisitioned the draft biographies for submission without Zhang Yushu, Chen Tingjing, or myself having reviewed them.
units.literal: Thus for several years the work was gathered into fascicles; but Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü continued to receive the supervising compiler's commission, requisitioned the biography drafts for submission, and Yushu, Tingjing, and your servant had none of them for review.

units.zh: 臣恐傳稿尚多舛誤，自蒙恩歸田，欲圖報稱，因重理舊編，搜殘補闕，復經五載，成列傳二百八巻。
units.en: Fearing the drafts were still flawed, I took up the old materials at home and spent five more years completing two hundred and eight fascicles of biographies.
units.literal: Your servant feared the biography drafts still had many errors; since receiving gracious favor to return to the fields and wishing to repay it, he therefore reworked the old compilation, gathering fragments and filling gaps; again after five years he completed two hundred and eight fascicles of biographies.

units.zh: 其間是非邪正，悉據公論，不敢稍逞私臆。
units.en: Throughout I followed received opinion on right and wrong and never let private prejudice intrude.
units.literal: Throughout, right and wrong, orthodox and heterodox, all followed public opinion; he did not dare slightly indulge private judgment.

units.zh: 但年代久遠，傳聞異辭，未敢自信爲是。
units.en: Yet the events were distant and sources conflicted, and I cannot claim complete certainty.
units.literal: But the years were remote and hearsay differed; he did not dare trust that it was correct.

units.zh: 謹繕寫全稿，齎呈禦鑑，請宣付史館，以備參考。」
units.en: I therefore submit the full fair copy for the emperor's inspection and ask that it be deposited in the Historiographical Bureau for reference."
units.literal: Respectfully he copied the complete draft, presented it before the Imperial Presence, and requested that it be announced and delivered to the Historiographical Institute for reference."

units.zh: 詔兪之。
units.en: The emperor approved the request.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 五十四年，復召來京修書，充省方盛典總裁官。
units.en: In year 54 he was summoned again to Beijing and made chief compiler of the record of the imperial southern tour.
units.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was again summoned to the capital to compile books and appointed chief compiler of the Imperial Tour Record.

units.zh: 雍正元年，卒於京。
units.en: He died in Beijing in the first year of the Yongzheng reign.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he died in the capital.

units.zh: 乾隆四十三年，國史館進鴻緒傳，髙宗命以郭琇劾疎載入，使後世知鴻緒輩罪狀。
units.en: In Qianlong 43 the Historiographical Institute submitted his biography; the Qianlong Emperor ordered Guo Xiu's impeachment memorial appended so posterity would know Wang Hongxu's offenses.
units.literal: In the forty-third year of Qianlong the State Historiographical Institute submitted Hongxu's biography; the Gaozong Emperor ordered that Guo Xiu's impeachment memorial be included, so that later generations would know the crimes of Hongxu and his kind.

units.zh: 孫興吾，進士，官吏部侍郎。
units.en: His grandson Xingwu, a jinshi, rose to Vice Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: His grandson Xingwu, a jinshi, served as Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 髙士奇，字澹人，浙江錢塘人。
units.en: Gao Shiqi, whose style was Danren, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Gao Shiqi, style name Danren, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 幼好學能文。
units.en: As a boy he loved study and wrote well.
units.literal: As a youth he loved learning and could compose essays.

units.zh: 貧，以監生就順天鄕試，充書寫序班。
units.en: In poverty he entered the Shuntian provincial exam as an academy student and was assigned to the scribes' roster.
units.literal: Poor, he took the Shuntian provincial examination as a student of the Imperial Academy, and was appointed to the clerical roster of scribes.

units.zh: 工書法，以明珠薦，入内廷供奉，授詹事府録事。
units.en: His fine calligraphy won him Mingzhu's recommendation; he entered the inner court as a personal attendant and was made a recorder in the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: Skilled in calligraphy, through Mingzhu's recommendation he entered the inner court as an attendant, and was appointed recorder in the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 遷内閣中書，食六品俸，賜居西安門内。
units.en: He was promoted to Grand Secretariat drafter on a sixth-rank salary and given a house inside Xi'an Gate.
units.literal: He was transferred to Secretariat drafter in the Grand Secretariat, drew salary of the sixth rank, and was granted a residence inside Xi'an Gate.

units.zh: 康熙十七年，聖祖降敕，以士奇書寫密諭及纂輯講章、詩文，供奉有年，特賜表裡十匹、銀五百。
units.en: In Kangxi 17 the emperor issued an edict praising Shiqi's years of service copying secret orders and compiling lecture materials and verse, and rewarded him with ten bolts of silk and five hundred taels of silver.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor issued an edict, stating that because Shiqi had copied secret instructions and compiled lecture chapters and literary compositions, serving for many years, he was specially granted ten bolts of fabric for outer and inner garments and five hundred taels of silver.

units.zh: 十九年，复諭吏部優敘，授爲額外翰林院侍講。
units.en: In year 19 the emperor again ordered the Board of Personnel to promote him specially to extra Hanlin Lecturer.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he again ordered the Board of Personnel to give preferential treatment, appointing him as extra Hanlin Academy Lecturer.

units.zh: 尋補侍讀，充日講起居注官，遷右庶子。
units.en: He soon became a full Reader, was made Daily Lecturer and court recorder, and was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: Soon he was made full Reader, appointed Daily Lecturer and Recorder, and promoted to Right Vice Director of the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 累擢詹事府少詹事。
units.en: He rose step by step to Junior Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Junior Vice Director in the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 二十六年，上謁陵，於成龍在道盡發明珠、餘國柱之私。
units.en: In year 26, during the imperial tomb visit, Yu Chenglong on the journey laid bare the secret dealings of Mingzhu and Yu Guozhu.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the emperor visited the imperial tombs, Yu Chenglong on the road fully exposed the private dealings of Mingzhu and Yu Guozhu.

units.zh: 駕旋，値太皇太后喪，不入宮，以成龍言問士奇，亦盡言之。
units.en: On the return journey the Grand Empress Dowager died; the emperor did not enter the palace but, on Chenglong's prompting, questioned Shiqi, who told everything he knew.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage returned, it happened to be the mourning for the Grand Empress Dowager; not entering the palace, on Chenglong's words the emperor questioned Shiqi, who also told all.

units.zh: 上曰：「何無人劾奏？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "Why has no one submitted an impeachment memorial?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "Why is there no one impeaching and memorializing?"

units.zh: 士奇對曰：「人孰不畏死。」
units.en: Shiqi answered, "Who is not afraid to die?"
units.literal: Shiqi replied: "Who does not fear death?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「若輩重於四輔臣乎？
units.en: The emperor said, "Do you think those men outweigh my four chief ministers?
units.literal: The emperor said: "Are those fellows weightier than the four chief ministers?

units.zh: 欲去則去之矣，有何懼？」
units.en: If I want them gone, they are gone—what is there to fear?"
units.literal: If I wish to remove them I can remove them; what is there to fear?"

units.zh: 未幾，郭琇疎上，明珠、國柱遂罷相。
units.en: Before long Guo Xiu's memorial arrived, and Mingzhu and Yu Guozhu were removed from office.
units.literal: Before long Guo Xiu's memorial went up, and Mingzhu and Guozhu were dismissed from the chief ministry.

units.zh: 二十七年，山東巡撫張汧以齎銀赴京行賄事發，逮治，獄辭渉士奇。
units.en: In year 27 Shandong Governor Zhang Qian was caught bringing silver to Beijing to bribe officials; when the case broke he was arrested, and the testimony implicated Gao Shiqi.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Shandong Governor Zhang Qian was prosecuted for bringing silver to the capital to offer bribes when the affair broke out; he was arrested and punished, and the case records implicated Shiqi.

units.zh: 會奉諭戒勿株連，於是置弗問。
units.en: Just then an edict warned against widening prosecutions by association, and the charges against him were dropped.
units.literal: It happened that an edict was received warning against implicating others by association; thereupon the matter was set aside without inquiry.

units.zh: 事
units.en: This case
units.literal: The affair

units.zh: 詳徐乾學傳。
units.en: The full account appears in Xu Qianxue's biography.
units.literal: The detailed account is in Xu Qianxue's biography.

units.zh: 士奇因疎言：「臣等編摩纂輯，惟在直廬。
units.en: Gao Shiqi then wrote: "We compilers work only in the direct halls of service.
units.literal: Shiqi therefore memorialized, saying: "Your servants' compilation and editing are only in the direct studios.

units.zh: 宣諭奏對，悉經中使。
units.en: Imperial orders and memorial audiences all go through palace eunuchs.
units.literal: Imperial instructions and responses to memorials all pass through eunuchs.

units.zh: 非進講，或數月不覲天顏，從未乾渉政事。
units.en: Unless we are lecturing, we may go months without seeing the emperor and never touch state policy.
units.literal: Except when entering to lecture, sometimes for months they do not behold the imperial countenance, and never at all involve themselves in government affairs.

units.zh: 不獨臣爲然，前入直諸臣，如熊賜履、葉方靄、張玉書、孫在豐、王士禎、硃彝尊等，近今同事諸臣，如陳廷敬、徐乾學、王鴻緒、張英、勵杜訥等，莫不皆然。
units.en: Nor was I alone: earlier men who served in the direct studios—Xiong Cilü, Ye Fang'ai, Zhang Yushu, Sun Zaifeng, Wang Shizhen, Zhu Yizun—and recent colleagues such as Chen Tingjing, Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, Zhang Ying, and Li Dun'e all followed the same rule.
units.literal: Not only your servant is so; former ministers on direct service such as Xiong Cilü, Ye Fang'ai, Zhang Yushu, Sun Zaifeng, Wang Shizhen, Zhu Yizun, and others, and recent colleagues such as Chen Tingjing, Xu Qianxue, Wang Hongxu, Zhang Ying, Li Dun'e, and others—none is not so.

units.zh: 獨是供奉日久，嫌疑日滋。
units.en: Only my long service has bred mounting suspicion.
units.literal: Only because service has been long, suspicion grows daily.

units.zh: 張汧無端疑怨，含沙汚衊，臣將無以自明，幸賴聖明在上，誣構難施。
units.en: Zhang Qian nursed groundless resentment and smeared me with innuendo; I could not have cleared my name but for the emperor's clear judgment, which thwarted the slander.
units.literal: Zhang Qian groundlessly harbored suspicion and resentment, casting sand to defile; your servant would have no way to clear himself, but fortunately relied on sage clarity above, so false construction could not be carried out.

units.zh: 但禁廷淸秘，來茲萋斐，豈容仍玷淸班？
units.en: Yet the inner precincts demand spotless reputations; how can I remain among the court's purest ranks if slander pursues me?
units.literal: But the inner court is pure and secret; if slander comes hereafter, how can one still stain the pure ranks?

units.zh: 伏乞賜歸田裡。」
units.en: I beg leave to return to my home district."
units.literal: Prostrate I beg to be granted return to my native village."

units.zh: 上命解任，仍領修書事。
units.en: The emperor dismissed him from office but left him in charge of the historical compilation.
units.literal: The emperor ordered him relieved of his post but still to head the book compilation.

units.zh: 二十八年，從上南巡，至杭州，幸士奇西溪山莊，御書「竹窗」榜額賜之。
units.en: In year 28 he accompanied the emperor on the southern tour; at Hangzhou the emperor visited Gao Shiqi's villa at Xixi and bestowed his own calligraphy, "Bamboo Window," as a plaque.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he accompanied the emperor on the southern tour; at Hangzhou the emperor visited Shiqi's Xixi mountain villa, and imperial calligraphy reading "Bamboo Window" was bestowed as a plaque.

units.zh: 未幾，左都御史郭琇劾奏曰：「皇上宵旰焦勞，勵精圖治，用人行政，未嘗纖毫假手左右。
units.en: Before long, the left censor-in-chief Guo Xiu submitted an impeachment memorial, saying: "Your Majesty rises early and retires late in anxious toil, striving to govern with vigor; in appointing officials and conducting state affairs, you have never yielded so much as a hair's breadth of authority to those beside you.
units.literal: Before long, Left Censor-in-Chief Guo Xiu memorialized, saying: "Your Majesty labors early and late with anxious toil, strives to refine governance, and in employing men and administering affairs has never entrusted so much as a thread's width to those at your side.

units.zh: 乃有原任少詹事髙士奇、左都御史王鴻緒等，表里爲姦，植黨營私，試略陳其罪。
units.en: Yet there remain the former junior mentor Gao Shiqi, the left censor-in-chief Wang Hongxu, and others, who are righteous in appearance yet treacherous at heart, who have formed factions and pursued private gain. I venture to outline their crimes briefly.
units.literal: Yet there are the former Junior Mentor Gao Shiqi, Left Censor-in-Chief Wang Hongxu, and others, who outwardly [appear loyal but] inwardly act as traitors, form factions and pursue private gain; I venture briefly to set forth their crimes.

units.zh: 士奇出身微賤，其始徒歩來京，覓館爲生。
units.en: Shiqi was born to humble station. At first he walked to the capital and found work as a tutor to earn his living.
units.literal: Shiqi came from a base origin; at first he came to the capital on foot, seeking employment in tutoring to make a living.

units.zh: 皇上因其字學頗工，不拘資格，擢補翰林。
units.en: The emperor, impressed by his accomplished calligraphy, overlooked formal qualifications and appointed him to the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: The Emperor, because his calligraphy was quite accomplished, without being bound by qualifications, promoted and supplemented him to the Hanlin.

units.zh: 令入南書房供奉，不過使之考訂文章，原未假之與聞政事。
units.en: He was assigned to the Southern Study to serve at court, merely to collate literary works; he was never meant to be drawn into matters of policy.
units.literal: He was ordered to enter the Southern Study to serve at court, merely to have him collate texts; originally he was not lent a share in hearing state affairs.

units.zh: 而士奇日思結納，諂附大臣，攬事招權，以圖分肥。
units.en: Yet day by day Shiqi sought connections, fawned upon high ministers, grasped at business and courted power, all to carve out his share of illicit gain.
units.literal: But Shiqi daily thought to cultivate connections, flattered and attached himself to great ministers, seized affairs and summoned power, in order to scheme for a share of profit.

units.zh: 内外大小臣工，無不知有士奇者。
units.en: Throughout the bureaucracy, great and small, none could fail to know of Shiqi.
units.literal: Inside and outside, great and small officials, there is none who does not know there is a Shiqi.

units.zh: 聲名赫奕，乃至如此。
units.en: His fame blazed so high that it reached this pitch.
units.literal: His fame blazing so splendidly, it has even come to this.

units.zh: 是其罪之可誅者一也。
units.en: This is the first count on which he deserves punishment.
units.literal: This is the first of his crimes that deserve execution.

units.zh: 久之羽翼既多，遂自立門戸，結王鴻緒爲死黨，給事中何楷爲義兄弟，翰林陳元龍爲叔侄，鴻緒兄頊齡爲子女姻親，倶寄以心腹，在外招攬。
units.en: In time his followers multiplied; he founded a faction of his own. He bound Wang Hongxu to him as a die-hard ally, took He Kai, a supervising secretary, as a sworn brother, treated the Hanlin academician Chen Yuanlong as kinsman in a patron–nephew bond, and linked his children's marriages to Hongxu's elder brother Xuling. All became his trusted agents, recruiting backers throughout the empire.
units.literal: After long time his wings being many, he then set up his own gate and household, joined Wang Hongxu as sworn faction-mates, the supervising secretary He Kai as sworn brothers, the Hanlin academician Chen Yuanlong as paternal uncle and nephew, Hongxu's elder brother Songling as marriage kin for their children; all were entrusted with his inmost trust, recruiting outside.

units.zh: 凡督、撫、籓、臬、道、府、廳、縣及在内大小卿員，皆鴻緒、楷等爲之居停，哄騙餽至，成千累萬。
units.en: Whether governors-general, governors, princes' establishments, provincial surveillants, circuit intendants, prefects, department heads, county magistrates, or great and petty officials at court—all relied on Hongxu, Kai, and the rest as go-betweens. Deceived and squeezed, they paid tribute that mounted to tens and hundreds of thousands.
units.literal: All governors, governors-general, princely establishments, provincial surveillance commissioners, circuit intendants, prefectures, departments, counties, and great and small court officials within—all had Hongxu, Kai, and the rest act as their brokers; deception and gifts arriving, piled in tens of thousands.

units.zh: 即不屬黨護者，亦有常例，名之曰'平安錢'。
units.en: Even officials outside their factional protection paid a standing levy, called "peace money."
units.literal: Even those not belonging to the faction's protection also had a standing practice; it was named 'peace money.'

units.zh: 是士奇等之姦貪壞法，全無顧忌，其罪之可誅者二也。
units.en: Thus Shiqi and his circle betrayed the law through treachery and greed, utterly without scruple—the second count deserving punishment.
units.literal: Thus Shiqi and the rest in treachery and greed destroying the law, wholly without scruple—the second of their crimes that deserve execution.

units.zh: 光棍兪子易，在京肆橫有年，事發潛遁。
units.en: One Yu Ziyi, a local bully who had long tyrannized the capital, fled in secret when the affair came to light.
units.literal: The rogue Yu Ziyi, in the capital wilfully violent for years, when the matter broke fled in secret.

units.zh: 有虎坊橋瓦房六十馀間，價値八千金，餽送士奇。
units.en: He owned more than sixty tiled houses at Tiger Bridge, worth eight thousand taels in gold, which he presented to Shiqi.
units.literal: There were more than sixty tile-roofed rooms at Tiger Bridge, valued at eight thousand taels of gold, presented as gifts to Shiqi.

units.zh: 此外順成門外斜街並各處房屋，令心腹出名置買，寄頓賄銀至四十馀萬。
units.en: Besides these, on the lane outside Shuncheng Gate and in other districts he had agents purchase property under other men's names, stashing bribe silver totaling more than four hundred thousand taels.
units.literal: Beyond this, houses on the slanting street outside Shuncheng Gate and at various places—he had confidants buy them under others' names, depositing bribe silver amounting to more than four hundred thousand.

units.zh: 又於本鄕平湖縣置田産千頃，大興土木，杭州西溪廣置園宅。
units.en: He also acquired a thousand qing of farmland in his native Pinghu County, undertook grand construction, and bought up estates and villas at West Brook near Hangzhou.
units.literal: Again in his native place Pinghu County he established a thousand qing of fields, greatly raised earth and wood, and at West Brook in Hangzhou broadly acquired gardens and mansions.

units.zh: 以覓館餬口之窮儒，忽爲數百萬之富翁。
units.en: A destitute scholar who once tutored for his bread had overnight become a man of millions.
units.literal: A poor scholar who sought tutoring to fill his mouth—suddenly became a man of millions.

units.zh: 試問金從何來？
units.en: Whence came this wealth?
units.literal: I ask: whence came the gold?

units.zh: 無非取給於各官。
units.en: None of it but wrung from officials.
units.literal: Nothing but taken and supplied from the various officials.

units.zh: 官從何來？
units.en: And whence came their wealth?
units.literal: Whence came the officials [their wealth]?

units.zh: 非侵國帑，即剝民膏。
units.en: Nothing but embezzled state funds or wrung from the people's substance.
units.literal: If not encroaching on the national treasury, then flaying the people's fat.

units.zh: 是士奇等眞國之蠹而民之賊也，其罪之可誅者三也。
units.en: Shiqi and his accomplices are veritable borers in the state timber and brigands against the people—the third count deserving punishment.
units.literal: Thus Shiqi and the rest are truly the state's borer and the people's brigand—the third of their crimes that deserve execution.

units.zh: 皇上洞悉其罪，因各館編纂未竣，令解任修書，矜全之恩至矣！
units.en: Your Majesty saw through their guilt; because the palace compilation projects were unfinished, you merely relieved them of office and kept them on to edit books—a mercy that went to the utmost!
units.literal: Your Majesty thoroughly understood their crimes; because compiling at the various libraries was not finished, ordered them relieved of office to edit books—grace of sparing to the utmost!

units.zh: 士奇不思改過自新，仍怙惡不悛，當聖駕南巡，上諭嚴戒餽送，以軍法治罪。
units.en: Shiqi did not repent or reform. He persisted in his wickedness. When Your Majesty made the southern tour, you decreed a strict ban on gifts, with military law for offenders.
units.literal: Shiqi did not think to reform and renew himself, still relied on evil without repentance; when the sacred chariot toured south, the Emperor instructed strict prohibition of gifts, with military law to punish crimes.

units.zh: 惟士奇與鴻緒愍不畏死，鴻緒在淮、揚等處，招攬各官餽送萬金，潛遺士奇。
units.en: Only Shiqi and Hongxu still defied the prohibition without fear of death. In Huai, Yang, and other regions Hongxu solicited gifts of ten thousand taels from officials and secretly forwarded them to Shiqi.
units.literal: Only Shiqi and Hongxu, heedless and not fearing death; Hongxu in Huai and Yang and other places recruited all officials' gifts of ten thousand gold, secretly sent to Shiqi.

units.zh: 淮、揚如此，他處可知。
units.en: If this was done in Huai and Yang, the rest may be imagined.
units.literal: Huai and Yang thus—other places can be known.

units.zh: 是士奇等欺君滅法，背公行私，其罪之可誅者四也。
units.en: Thus they deceived the throne and nullified the law, betraying the public good for private gain—the fourth count deserving punishment.
units.literal: Thus Shiqi and the rest deceived the ruler and extinguished the law, turned their backs on the public and practiced the private—the fourth of their crimes that deserve execution.

units.zh: 王鴻緒、陳元龍鼎甲出身，儼然士林翹楚；
units.en: Wang Hongxu and Chen Yuanlong had risen as palace graduates and stood among the foremost scholars of the realm;
units.literal: Wang Hongxu, Chen Yuanlong—chief graduates in origin, augustly the forest of letters' lofty pinnacles;

units.zh: 竟不顧淸議，依媚大臣，無所不至。
units.en: yet they spurned public opinion and fawned upon great ministers to the utmost.
units.literal: Yet did not care for pure criticism, leaned and fawned on great ministers, nothing they did not reach.

units.zh: 苟圖富貴，傷敗名教，豈不玷朝班而羞當世之士哉？
units.en: To grasp at riches and rank while trampling the norms of propriety—does this not dishonor the court and shame the scholars of the age?
units.literal: If only seeking wealth and rank, injuring and destroying the teaching of names—does this not stain the court ranks and shame the men of the age?

units.zh: 總之髙士奇、王鴻緒、陳元龍、何楷、王頊齡等，豺狼其性，蛇蠍其心，鬼蜮其形。
units.en: In sum, Gao Shiqi, Wang Hongxu, Chen Yuanlong, He Kai, Wang Xuling, and the rest have the nature of wolves, hearts of scorpions, and faces of ogres.
units.literal: In sum Gao Shiqi, Wang Hongxu, Chen Yuanlong, He Kai, Wang Songling, and the rest—wolves and dogs their nature, serpents and scorpions their heart, demons and sprites their form.

units.zh: 畏勢者既觀望而不敢言，趨勢者復擁戴而不肯言。
units.en: Those who fear power hold their tongues and watch from the sidelines; those who court power rally to them and will not speak out.
units.literal: Those who fear power already look on and dare not speak; those who court power again rally and support and are unwilling to speak.

units.zh: 臣若不言，有負聖恩。
units.en: If I remain silent, I fail Your Majesty's grace.
units.literal: If your servant does not speak, he has failed the sacred grace.

units.zh: 故不避嫌怨，請立賜罷斥，明正典刑，天下幸甚。」
units.en: Therefore, heedless of enmity, I beg that they be dismissed at once and punished according to law, to the great good of the realm."
units.literal: Therefore not avoiding suspicion and resentment, I request forthwith to be granted dismissal and expulsion, clearly to rectify by the statutes—great fortune for all under Heaven."

units.zh: 疎入，士奇等倶休致回籍。
units.en: When the memorial was received, Shiqi and the others were all allowed to retire and return to their home districts.
units.literal: When the memorial entered, Shiqi and the rest all retired on leave and returned to their native places.

units.zh: 副都御史許三禮复疎劾解任尚書徐乾學與士奇姻親，招搖納賄，相爲表裡。
units.en: The vice censor-in-chief Xu Sanli submitted a further memorial impeaching the retired minister Xu Qianxue, who was related to Shiqi by marriage, for taking bribes and colluding with him as partners inside and outside the court.
units.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Sanli again memorialized impeaching the relieved Minister Xu Qianxue as marriage kin with Shiqi, swaggering and receiving bribes, mutually acting as outside and inside.

units.zh: 部議以所劾無據，得寢。
units.en: The ministry ruled that the charges lacked evidence, and the case was dropped.
units.literal: The ministry deliberated that the impeached matters had no evidence; the matter was shelved.

units.zh: 三十三年，召來京修書。
units.en: In the thirty-third year of the Kangxi reign, he was recalled to the capital to work on the compilation.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year, he was summoned to the capital to edit books.

units.zh: 士奇既至，仍直南書房。
units.en: When Shiqi arrived, he again served on duty in the Southern Study.
units.literal: Shiqi having arrived, still attended directly at the Southern Study.

units.zh: 三十六年，以養母乞歸，詔允之，特授詹事府詹事。
units.en: In the thirty-sixth year he asked leave to return home to care for his mother. The emperor granted it and specially appointed him junior tutor in the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, on grounds of nourishing his mother he begged to return; an edict approved it, and he was specially made Junior Tutor of the Mansion of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 尋擢禮部侍郎，以母老未赴。
units.en: He was soon promoted to vice minister of rites but did not take up the post because his mother was elderly.
units.literal: Soon promoted Vice Minister of Rites; because his mother was old he did not go to assume office.

units.zh: 四十二年，上南巡，士奇迎駕淮安，扈蹕至杭州。
units.en: In the forty-second year, when the emperor toured the south, Shiqi met the imperial procession at Huai'an and accompanied it to Hangzhou.
units.literal: In the forty-second year, when the Emperor made a southern tour, Shiqi welcomed the imperial carriage at Huai'an and escorted the retinue to Hangzhou.

units.zh: 及回鑾，復從至京師，屢入對，賜予優渥。
units.en: When the emperor turned homeward, Shiqi again accompanied him to the capital, was received in audience many times, and was granted lavish favors.
units.literal: When the imperial chariot returned, again followed to the capital, repeatedly entered for audience, gifts and favors generous and thick.

units.zh: 上顧侍臣曰：「朕初讀書，内監授以四子本經，作時文；
units.en: Turning to his attendants the emperor said: "When I first began to study, eunuchs taught me the Four Books in their original text, so I could write examination essays.
units.literal: The Emperor looked at the attending ministers and said: "When I first studied, the eunuchs taught me the Four Books text in the original, to compose examination essays;

units.zh: 得士奇，始知學問門徑。
units.en: It was only when I found Shiqi that I learned the true approach to learning.
units.literal: Having obtained Shiqi, I then knew the entrance to scholarship.

units.zh: 初見士奇得古人詩文，一覽即知其時代，心以爲異，未幾，朕亦能之。
units.en: When I first saw Shiqi take up a piece of ancient poetry or prose and identify its period at a glance, I marveled at it; before long I could do the same myself.
units.literal: At first, seeing Shiqi take up ancient poetry and prose and know their period at a glance, I thought it strange in my heart; before long, I too could do it.

units.zh: 士奇無戰陣功，而朕待之厚，以其裨朕學問者大也。」
units.en: Shiqi won no laurels in war, yet I have treated him generously because he has done so much to advance my scholarship."
units.literal: Shiqi has no battle-array achievements, yet I treat him thickly, because his benefit to my learning is great."

units.zh: 尋遣歸，是年卒於家。
units.en: Soon afterward he was sent home, and that same year he died there.
units.literal: Soon he was sent home; that year he died at home.

units.zh: 上深惜之，命加給全葬，授其子庶吉士輿爲編修。
units.en: The emperor grieved deeply, ordered a full state funeral subsidy, and appointed his son Yu, then a Hanlin bachelor, as compiler.
units.literal: The Emperor deeply regretted it, ordered added grants for a full funeral, and appointed his son, the Hanlin bachelor Yu, as Compiler.

units.zh: 尋諡文恪。
units.en: He was soon given the posthumous name Wenke.
units.literal: Soon posthumous title Wenke.

units.zh: 論曰：儒臣直内廷，謂之「書房」，存未入關前舊名也。
units.en: The historians observe: When scholar-officials served on duty in the inner court, it was called the "Study," preserving the old name from before the conquest of the Pass.
units.literal: The historian comments: When Confucian officials attend directly in the inner court, it is called the "Study," preserving the old name from before entering the Pass.

units.zh: 上書房授諸皇子讀，尊爲師傅；
units.en: The Upper Study instructed the princes and was held in honor as their masters;
units.literal: The Upper Study instructs the imperial sons in reading, honored as masters;

units.zh: 南書房以詩文書畫供禦，地分淸切，參與密勿。
units.en: The Southern Study supplied poetry, prose, calligraphy, and painting for the emperor's use. Its station was eminent and close; its members took part in confidential deliberations.
units.literal: The Southern Study supplies poetry, prose, calligraphy, and painting for imperial use; its station is pure and close, and it takes part in confidential counsel.

units.zh: 乾學、士奇先後入直，鴻緒亦以文學進。
units.en: Qianxue and Shiqi entered service in turn; Hongxu also rose through literary accomplishment.
units.literal: Qianxue and Shiqi first and after entered direct attendance; Hongxu also advanced by literary accomplishment.

units.zh: 乃憑藉權勢，互結黨援，納賄營私，致屢遭彈劾，聖祖曲予保全。
units.en: Yet they leaned on power, formed factions, accepted bribes, and pursued private gain, and were impeached again and again; the Kangxi Emperor leniently preserved them.
units.literal: Yet relying on power and influence, mutually forming factional support, receiving bribes and pursuing private gain, thereby frequently suffering impeachment—the Kangxi Emperor bent to spare and preserve them.

units.zh: 乾學、鴻緒猶得以書局自隨，竟編纂之業，士奇亦以恩禮終，不其幸歟！
units.en: Qianxue and Hongxu were still allowed to keep their place at the compilation bureau and finish their editorial work; Shiqi too died with imperial favor intact—is this not extraordinary fortune?
units.literal: Qianxue and Hongxu still could take the book bureau with them, finishing the work of compilation; Shiqi also ended with favor and ritual—was it not their fortune!
